model.name: revocation.commitCoupleList
model.description: L1: commit-couple the revoked list to REVOKED_ARMED so armed + its list ship atomically and cannot diverge across deploys; the list holds SALTED HASHES (safe-to-track, not credentials) AND the server LOAD PATH == the gated list path (path-unify catch). Makes the armed-but-empty state unreachable.
